tokenize_text_with_bert: use BertTokenizer to tokenize text into wordpiece tokens using a vocab file
convert_tokens_to_ids: convert a list of wordpiece tokens into their corresponding vocabulary IDs
load_vocab_from_file: load a vocabulary file into an ordered dictionary mapping tokens to integer indices
whitespace_tokenize_text: split text into tokens by stripping and splitting on whitespace
wordpiece_tokenize_text: tokenize text into subword pieces using a greedy longest-match-first algorithm
